'''Nobuo Tobita''' (Japanese: '''飛田展男''' ''Tobita Nobuo'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}. He was born on November 6, 1959 in {{wp|Mito, Ibaraki|Mito}}, {{wp|Ibaraki Prefecture|Ibaraki}}, {{wp|Japan}}.
